newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up on fund shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up on fund shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates ended up on Monday because of a fund shortage and are likely to remain firm on Tuesday, dealers said.

"Initially the bids and offers were made at 19.90 and 20 percent, but the rates slightly slipped later to the level of 19.50 percent," a dealer said. "But by midday, the rates bounced back on fund shortage to 20 percent."
One-week borrowers were unable to cover positions at around 16 percent, while two-week bids and offers remained mismatched at 15 and 18 percent, dealers said. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
